exceptions.rationale: This stateless internal verifier chain accepts only dedicated service HTTP Basic credentials, never browser cookies. The 2026-10-16 review covers POST token verification and account lookup plus GET-only internal account directory routes; every route requires the verifier role and all other methods are denied. CSRF does not protect these non-browser, non-cookie calls. Cookie-only and incorrect credentials remain denied by integration tests. Fresh hosted CodeQL analysis remains required.

The 2026-10-16 CodeQL review covers only the dedicated internal test-account operator chain. It is enabled only in Local, requires a separate long operator secret in HTTP Basic on each request, creates no session, and denies every unlisted method. Browser cookies alone and wrong credentials receive 401 without a Set-Cookie response in TestAccountHttpTest. CSRF tokens do not protect this non-browser, non-cookie maintenance channel. This file-scoped exception expires on 2026-10-19 and requires fresh hosted CodeQL validation.
